ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Lore uses your location to show questions near you. You can also use the app without sharing your location.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Lore uses your location to notify you about new questions nearby.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lore accesses a single photo you choose from your library so you can set it as your profile avatar.
